caption.en: Here is a shape on square grid paper, with a dashed line down the middle. Imagine folding the paper along the line.
caption.zh: 方格纸上有一个图形，中间一条虚线。想一想沿这条线把纸对折。

caption.en: The two halves match exactly, with nothing sticking out. The shape is symmetric, and the fold line is a line of symmetry.
caption.zh: 两半完全重合，没有露出来的地方。这个图形是对称图形，折痕这条线叫对称轴。

words.zh: 对折：有露出来的部分（斜线处）

caption.en: This L shape does not match when folded along the line: part of it sticks out. The line is not a line of symmetry.
caption.zh: 这个 L 形沿线对折不重合，有一部分露在外面。这条线不是对称轴。

words.en: outline matches · shaded square does not (hatched)

caption.zh: 外形重合了，可是涂色的格折过去落在空格上。图形的每一部分都要重合，里面也一样。

prompt.en: Fold along the dashed line. Do the two halves match?

guide.en: Fold in your head: the part on one side of the line turns over onto the other side. A line of symmetry makes the two halves match exactly.

caption.en: Is this line a line of symmetry of the rectangle? Fold along it: the halves match, so yes.

prompt.en: Is the dashed line a line of symmetry of the rectangle?
prompt.zh: 虚线是长方形的对称轴吗？

guide.en: Fold in your head: the part on one side of the line turns over onto the other side. A line of symmetry makes the two halves match exactly.
guide.zh: 在脑子里折一折：线一边的部分翻到另一边。是对称轴，两半就完全重合。

hints.en: Picture folding the paper along the line. Does every part land on another part?
hints.zh: 想象沿这条线把纸对折。每一部分都落在另一部分上吗？

correct.en: Yes. Folded along the line, parts stick out: it is not a line of symmetry.
correct.zh: 对。沿这条线折，有露出来的部分，它不是对称轴。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold along the line in your head and look for anything that sticks out.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在脑子里沿线折一折，看看有没有露出来的部分。

reveal.en: When folded, parts stick out, so the dashed line is not a line of symmetry.
reveal.zh: 折起来有露出来的部分，所以虚线不是对称轴。

say.en: The line cuts the shape into two halves of the same size, but fold it: corners stick out. Equal halves are not enough; they must match.
say.zh: 这条线把图形分成一样大的两半，可是折一折，有角露出来。一样大还不够，要重合。

prompt.en: Which of these figures are symmetric? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些是对称图形？全部选出来。

guide.en: A figure is symmetric if some fold, in any direction, makes its two halves match exactly.
guide.zh: 只要有一种折法（任何方向）能让两半完全重合，就是对称图形。

hints.en: Try to fold each figure along some line: up, across or slanted.
hints.zh: 试着把每个图形沿某条线折：竖的、横的或斜的。

correct.en: Yes. Each figure you chose folds onto itself along some line; the others do not.
correct.zh: 对。选的每个图形都能沿某条线折得重合，其余的不能。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a fold line in every direction, and check any shaded squares.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每个方向都找一找折线，也看看涂色的格。

reveal.en: The symmetric figures have at least one line along which they fold onto themselves.
reveal.zh: 对称图形至少有一条线，沿着它折能重合。

say.en: Turn the page in your head: the figure still folds onto itself along a slanted line. A line of symmetry does not have to stand straight up.
say.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转：沿斜着的线，图形还是能折得重合。对称轴不一定是竖的。

say.en: The line cuts the shape into two halves of the same size, but fold it: corners stick out. Equal halves are not enough; they must match.
say.zh: 这条线把图形分成一样大的两半，可是折一折，有角露出来。一样大还不够，要重合。

say.en: The outline matches, but a shaded square lands on a blank one. Every part has to match, inside too.
say.zh: 外形重合了，可是涂色的格折过去落在空格上。里面的每一部分也要重合。

prompt.en: Which of these dashed lines are lines of symmetry of the square? Choose all.
prompt.zh: 哪几条虚线是这个正方形的对称轴？全部选出来。

guide.en: Test each line by folding along it. Equal halves are not enough: they must match.
guide.zh: 每条线都沿它折一折来检验。分成一样大的两半还不够，要重合。

hints.en: Fold the shape along each line in your head.
hints.zh: 在脑子里沿每条线把图形折一折。

correct.en: Yes. Only those lines fold the square onto itself.
correct.zh: 对。只有这几条线能让正方形折得重合。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold along each line and check the corners.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿每条线折一折，看看各个角。

reveal.en: The lines of symmetry of the square are the ones along which its halves match.
reveal.zh: 正方形的对称轴，是沿着它折两半能重合的那几条线。

say.en: Fold the square along a diagonal: the halves match, so a square has 4 lines of symmetry. A rectangle's diagonal does not work.
say.zh: 正方形沿对角线折，两半重合，所以正方形有 4 条对称轴。长方形的对角线不行。

prompt.zh: 这个梯形侧放着。哪条虚线是它的对称轴？

guide.en: Only one of the dashed lines folds the shape onto itself. Test each by folding.
guide.zh: 只有一条虚线能让图形折得重合。每条都折一折来检验。

hints.en: Look at which way the shape points: its line of symmetry runs the same way.
hints.zh: 看看图形朝哪边：对称轴顺着同一个方向。

correct.en: Yes. Folded along that line, the two halves match exactly.

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold along each line in your head and check the corners.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在脑子里沿每条线折一折，看看各个角。

reveal.en: The line of symmetry is the one along which the halves match exactly.
reveal.zh: 对称轴是沿着它折两半能完全重合的那条线。

say.zh: 朝右斜的半格，翻过去要朝左斜。折过去看一看斜边。

prompt.en: Complete the figure: put down the partner of each corner. The line is a line of symmetry.
prompt.zh: 补全图形：放下每个顶点的对应点。这条线是对称轴。

guide.en: Every corner has a partner on the other side of the line, the same distance away. Put the partners down in order; the line joins them.
guide.zh: 每个顶点在对称轴另一边都有一个对应点，离轴一样远。按顺序放下对应点，线会把它们连起来。

hints.en: Take one corner at a time: count how far it is from the line, then count the same on the other side.
hints.zh: 一个顶点一个顶点地找：数它离轴几格，再在另一边数同样的格数。

correct.en: Yes. Every part has its partner, the same distance from the line on the other side: fold it and the halves match.
correct.zh: 对。每一部分都有对应部分，在轴的另一边离轴一样远：折起来两半重合。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check each part: count from the line on one side, then the same on the other side.
fallback.zh: 还没对。逐一检查：从轴数到这一部分，再在另一边数同样远。

reveal.en: The dashed outline shows the other half: each part turned over the line, the same distance away.
reveal.zh: 虚线画出了另一半：每一部分翻过对称轴，离轴一样远。

say.en: Count from the line: each square's partner is the same number of squares from the line, on the other side. Yours are a little off.
say.zh: 从对称轴数：每个格的对应格在另一边，离轴的格数一样。你的离轴远近不对。
